visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: defaultdict Instead of Checking for the Key
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every word first checks whether its key exists and creates an empty list if not. Use defaultdict(list). The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
from collections import defaultdict

words = ["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"]
groups = defaultdict(list)
for word in words:
    groups["".join(sorted(word))].append(word)
print(list(groups.values()))
solution.explanation: defaultdict creates the empty list the first time a key is used, so the "is the key there yet?" branch disappears.
